scripts.db:seed: tsx db/seed.ts && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy

APP_URL.description: Optional. Leave blank: the app uses whatever URL it is served on. Set it (no trailing slash) only to pin one origin, for example when the Worker is reachable on both workers.dev and a custom domain.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Optional. Leave blank and a secret is generated on first run and stored in D1. To manage it yourself, use `openssl rand -base64 32`. Changing it signs everyone out.

OWNER_CLAIM_TOKEN.description: Optional but recommended. Any long random phrase. The first account on a new server becomes its owner; with this set, only `https://YOUR-URL/register?claim=<phrase>` can create it, so a stranger cannot get there first.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional, and needs the Workers Paid plan ($5/month). Sender for password-reset email, like `chat@yourdomain.com`, on a domain in Cloudflare DNS set up under Email → Email Sending. Also add `"send_email": [{ "name": "EMAIL" }]` to wrangler.jsonc. Leave blank on the free plan: the server owner makes reset links instead.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Optional. Public Turnstile site key. The default is Cloudflare's always-pass test key. Replace it together with `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` when you create a real widget.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional. Turnstile secret. Leave blank to skip the check. The value in `.dev.vars.example` is Cloudflare's always-pass test secret.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Google OAuth client id. Callback URL is `https://YOUR-APP-DOMAIN/api/auth/callback/google`.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. Google OAuth client secret. Leave blank to hide the Google button.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. GitHub OAuth client id. Callback URL is `https://YOUR-APP-DOMAIN/api/auth/callback/github`.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. GitHub OAuth client secret. Leave blank to hide the GitHub button.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional, for voice. Your Cloudflare account id. Voice stays disabled until this, `REALTIMEKIT_APP_ID`, and `CLOUDFLARE_REALTIME_API_TOKEN` are all set.

REALTIMEKIT_APP_ID.description: Optional, for voice. RealtimeKit app id from the Cloudflare dashboard (Realtime → RealtimeKit).

CLOUDFLARE_REALTIME_API_TOKEN.description: Optional, for voice. API token with Realtime permissions. After the three RealtimeKit secrets are set, run `npm run realtimekit:presets` once.

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Optional. R2 access key so browsers upload straight to the bucket. When blank, the Worker proxies uploads.

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Optional. R2 secret for the access key above. When blank, the Worker proxies uploads.
